archetypes.name: dyn-ratchet-identity
archetypes.rationale: Identity tuples and occurrence ordering are the riskiest linter contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the two new AST linters for stable qualified-symbol and occurrence assignment. Check that suppression, exemptions, and baselines never renumber sibling findings. Pay special attention to nested function, class, and module scopes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-baseline-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Baseline regeneration now affects py-lint and pre-commit behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review baseline load, write, reason preservation, duplicate detection, and exemption validation for both ratchets. Verify the Makefile and pre-commit wiring invoke the intended CLI verbs and that generated baselines remain canonical and byte-stable. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
